author: aarvee11
body:
#### Description

Adding the initial implementation of the `isolationforestprocessor` for OpenTelemetry Collector.  
This feature introduces anomaly detection using the Online Isolation Forest algorithm applied to streaming - traces, metrics, and logs. The processor evaluates each incoming signal and tags it with an `anomaly_score` and `anomaly_is_anomaly` attribute based on a configurable threshold and contamination rate using a moving time window enabling us to perform anomaly detection in near-realtime instead of performing the same as an async analysis increasing the MTTD.

This lays the foundation for unsupervised anomaly detection in observability pipelines.

#### Link to tracking issue  
[New component: Isolation-Forest anomaly detection Processor #41707](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/issues/41707)

#### Testing

- Added unit tests to validate configuration, scoring logic, and processor behavior.
- Validated processor against sample traces in a local OpenTelemetry Collector build.
- Verified anomaly score computation and tagging of spans via debug logs.

#### Documentation

- Added `README.md` under `processor/isolationforestprocessor/` detailing:
  - Usage
  - Configuration options
  - Example pipeline
- Included in `factory.go` registration to enable processor in custom collector builds.

### Core Application Structure

- **tsconfig.json**: Comprehensive TypeScript configuration with strict type checking and path mapping for clean imports
- **package.json**: Updated with React Navigation dependencies and proper project metadata

- `OnboardingContainer.tsx` - Welcome and initial setup flow
- `CheckInContainer.tsx` - User check-in functionality 
- `SymptomCheckerContainer.tsx` - Symptom assessment interface
- `ClaimFormContainer.tsx` - Insurance claim submission
- `ClaimStatusContainer.tsx` - Claim tracking and status updates
- `ClaimRejectionContainer.tsx` - Appeal process for denied claims
- `AccessibilityContextProvider.tsx` - Global accessibility state management with voice mode and font size controls
- `useOCRScan.ts` - Custom hook for document scanning functionality

Located in `src/components/`, these provide reusable UI elements with accessibility features:

- `VoiceModeToggle.tsx` - Toggle for voice interaction mode
- `SpeechToTextInput.tsx` - Voice input component with recording indicators

- `SimpleLanguageGuide.tsx` - Plain language explanations for medical terms

- `SmartForm.tsx` - Dynamic form generator with validation

**Claims Management:**

- `AppealOptions.tsx` - Available appeal paths with difficulty indicators

- `MicroStoriesCarousel.tsx` - Educational content carousel

### Custom Hooks

### Development Infrastructure
- **ESLint Configuration**: TypeScript-aware linting with React Native community standards
- **Jest Testing Setup**: Configured for React Native with TypeScript support
- **Babel Configuration**: Metro bundler setup for React Native
- **Android Documentation**: Comprehensive setup guide in `README.md` with emulator and device instructions

### Accessibility First
Every component includes accessibility considerations:
- Screen reader support with proper labeling
- Voice mode integration throughout the app
- Adjustable font sizes and high contrast support
- Speech-to-text input for hands-free operation
- Text-to-speech feedback for audio assistance

body:
This PR updates [coverage](https://pypi.org/project/coverage) from **6.1.1** to **7.10.3**.



<details>
  <summary>Changelog</summary>
  
  
   ### 7.10.3
   ```
   ---------------------------

- Fixes for ``patch = subprocess``:

  - If subprocesses spawned yet more subprocesses simultaneously, some coverage
    could be missed.  This is now fixed, closing `issue 2024`_.

  - If subprocesses were created in other directories, their data files were
    stranded there and not combined into the totals, as described in `issue
    2025`_.  This is now fixed.

  - On Windows (or maybe only some Windows?) the patch would fail with a
    ``ModuleNotFound`` error trying to import coverage.  This is now fixed,
    closing `issue 2022`_.

  - Originally only options set in the coverage configuration file would apply
    to subprocesses.  Options set on the ``coverage run`` command line (such as
    ``--branch``) wouldn't be communicated to the subprocesses.  This could
    lead to combining failures, as described in `issue 2021`_. Now the entire
    configuration is used in subprocesses, regardless of its origin.

  - Added ``debug=patch`` to help diagnose problems.

- Fix: really close all SQLite databases, even in-memory ones. Closes `issue
  2017`_.

.. _issue 2017: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/2017
.. _issue 2021: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/2021
.. _issue 2022: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/2022
.. _issue 2024: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/2024
.. _issue 2025: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/2025


.. _changes_7-10-2:
   ```
   
  
  
   ### 7.10.2
   ```
   ---------------------------

- Fix: some code with NOP bytecodes could report missing branches that are
  actually executed. This is now fixed, closing `issue 1999`_. Python 3.9
  still shows the problem.

.. _issue 1999: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/1999


.. _changes_7-10-1:
   ```
   
  
  
   ### 7.10.1
   ```
   ---------------------------

- Fix: the exclusion for ``if TYPE_CHECKING:`` was wrong: it marked the branch
  as partial, but it should have been a line exclusion so the entire clause
  would be excluded. Improves `issue 831`_.

- Fix: changed where .pth files are written for ``patch = subprocess``, closing
  `issue 2006`_.

.. _issue 2006: https://github.com/nedbat/coveragepy/issues/2006


.. _changes_7-10-0:
   ```
   
  
  
   ### 7.10.0
   ```
   ---------------------------

- A new configuration option: ":ref:`config_run_patch`" specifies named patches
  to work around some limitations in coverage measurement.  These patches are
  available:

  - ``patch = _exit`` lets coverage save its data even when :func:`os._exit()
    <python:os._exit>` is used to abruptly end the process.  This closes
    long-standing `issue 310`_ as well as its duplicates: `issue 312`_, `issue
    1673`_, `issue 1845`_, and `issue 1941`_.

  - ``patch = subprocess`` measures coverage in Python subprocesses created
    with :mod:`subprocess`, :func:`os.system`, or one of the :func:`execv
    <python:os.execl>` or :func:`spawnv <python:os.spawnl>` family of
    functions. Closes old `issue 367`_, its duplicate `issue 378`_ and old
    `issue 689`_.

  - ``patch = execv`` adjusts the :func:`execv <python:os.execl>` family of
    functions to save coverage data before ending the current program and
    starting the next. Not available on Windows. Closes `issue 43`_ after 15
    years!

- The HTML report now dimly colors subsequent lines in multi-line statements.
  They used to have no color.  This gives a better indication of the amount of
  code missing in the report.  Closes `issue 1308`_.

- Two new exclusion patterns are part of the defaults: ``...`` is automatically
  excluded as a line and ``if TYPE_CHECKING:`` is excluded as a branch.  Closes
  `issue 831`_.

- A new command-line option: ``--save-signal=USR1`` specifies a signal that
  coverage.py will listen for.  When the signal is sent, the coverage data will
  be saved.  This makes it possible to save data from within long-running
  processes.  Thanks, `Arkady Gilinsky <pull 1998_>`_.

- A new configuration option: ":ref:`config_report_partial_also`" is a list of
  regexes to add as pragmas for partial branches.  This parallels the
  ":ref:`config_report_exclude_also`" setting for adding line exclusion
  patterns.

- A few file path configuration settings didn't allow for tilde expansion:
  :ref:`config_json_output`, :ref:`config_lcov_output` and
  :ref:`config_run_debug_file`.  This is now fixed.

- Wheels are included for 3.14 now that 3.14 rc1 is available.

- We no longer ship a PyPy-specific wheel. PyPy will install the pure-Python
  wheel.  Closes `issue 2001`_.

- In the very unusual situation of not having a current frame, coverage no
  longer crashes when using the sysmon core, fixing `issue 2005`_.

body:
This PR fixes a critical issue where malformed DNS packets would cause the application to panic and terminate. The crash occurred in the `ParseResourceRecord` function when attempting to parse DNS resource records with insufficient data.

## Problem

The application would crash with a panic like:
```
runtime error: slice bounds out of range [:130] with capacity 35
```

This happened because the `ParseResourceRecord` function performed slice operations without bounds checking. When a malformed DNS packet claimed to have more data than was actually available (e.g., RDLength claiming 100 bytes but only 5 bytes remaining), the slice operation would panic and crash the entire DNS server.

## Solution

The fix implements proper error handling and bounds checking:

1. **Modified `ParseResourceRecord` function signature** to return `(ResourceRecord, error)` instead of panicking
2. **Added comprehensive bounds checking** before all slice operations:
   - Validates sufficient data exists for fixed fields (type, class, TTL, RDLength)
   - Validates sufficient data exists for the claimed RData length
3. **Updated all calling sites** to handle errors gracefully by logging and continuing processing
4. **Added comprehensive test coverage** for malformed data scenarios

## Key Benefits

- **Server stability**: Malformed DNS packets no longer crash the application
- **Error visibility**: Parse errors are logged with detailed information for analysis
- **Continued operation**: Server continues processing other requests when one fails
- **Minimal changes**: Only added error handling where needed, no major refactoring

## Example Error Messages

The fix provides clear error messages for different failure scenarios:
```
Error parsing AN record 0: insufficient data for RData: need 130 bytes, have 35
Error parsing NS record 1: insufficient data for resource record fixed fields: need 16 bytes, have 8
```

This ensures that malicious or corrupted DNS data cannot take down the DNS server, while providing administrators with the information needed to analyze problematic packets.

Fixes #9.

# [Critical] Fix Resource Leaks and Session Management in MCPClientMixin

## Issue
The `MCPClientMixin` class has critical resource management issues that can cause:

1. **Session Leaks**: Sessions are never properly closed when tasks are interrupted or cancelled
2. **Zombie Sessions**: Failed session cleanup leaves orphaned connections
3. **Resource Exhaustion**: No limits on concurrent sessions per client
4. **Race Conditions**: Multiple tasks can create duplicate sessions simultaneously
5. **Memory Growth**: Task session dictionary grows indefinitely without cleanup

## Root Cause
The `get_session()` context manager in `MCPClientMixin` (paste-4.txt) has flawed session lifecycle management:

- Sessions aren't closed on task cancellation
- No cleanup for interrupted tasks
- Dictionary grows without bounds
- Race conditions in session creation
- Exception handling doesn't guarantee cleanup

## Problem

Users could start multiple treatments of the same type simultaneously, leading to data inconsistencies and potential confusion in treatment tracking. The app lacked validation to check if a user already had an incomplete treatment before allowing them to start a new one.

## Solution

This PR implements comprehensive duplicate treatment prevention logic that:

1. **Checks episode history** before allowing new treatments using the existing `ApiService.getEpisodeHistory()` method
2. **Validates against ongoing treatments** by checking if any episode exists where `treatment == selectedTreatment` AND `procedure_completed == false` for the current user
3. **Provides clear user feedback** via SnackBar messages when duplicates are detected
4. **Covers all treatment types** including Prosthesis Fitted, Implant, Tooth Fracture, Tooth Taken Out, Root Canal/Filling, and Braces

## Implementation Details

### Helper Functions Added
- `_checkForOngoingTreatment()`: Fetches episode history and validates for duplicates
- `_showOngoingTreatmentSnackBar()`: Displays user-friendly error messages

### Treatment Flows Updated
The duplicate check is now applied to all 7 treatment start flows before calling `ApiService.saveTreatmentInfo`:

```dart
// Check for ongoing treatment before proceeding
final hasOngoing = await _checkForOngoingTreatment(selectedTreatment, username);
if (hasOngoing) {
  _showOngoingTreatmentSnackBar(selectedTreatment);
  return;
}
// Continue with normal treatment creation...
```

### Error Handling
- Graceful fallback if API calls fail (allows treatment to proceed)
- Console logging for debugging
- Non-blocking user experience

## Testing

The implementation follows the DRY principle with reusable helper functions and maintains backward compatibility. Users will now see a clear message like "You already have an ongoing Implant. Please complete it first." when attempting to start duplicate treatments.

## Files Changed
- `toothcareapp_frontend/lib/screens/treatment_screen.dart` - Added helper functions and duplicate checks to all treatment flows

This is a surgical change that adds validation without modifying existing functionality or data structures.

This PR delivers several UX and stability improvements focused on the start screen, logging system, quirk reset behavior, defeated opponents tracking, and card unlock mechanics.

## Key Changes

### Start Modal Polish
Enhanced the visual design with a stronger dim overlay (75% opacity) and improved fog effects with multiple gradient layers for better contrast. Added text-shadow to mottos for better readability against the animated background while preserving the static logo and maintaining accessibility with motion-sensitive user support.

### Logging System Fixes
Resolved runtime "log is not a function" errors during debug tests and gameplay by adding defensive type checking. Enhanced opponent action logging to display actual opponent names (e.g., `[Gronky the Trickster] hits for 3`) instead of generic `[opp]` labels, making logs more contextual and readable.

### Quirk Selection Persistence
Implemented proper quirk persistence using localStorage with automatic clearing on all reset flows including game restarts, victory modal actions, and clear unlocks operations. Selected quirks now persist across page reloads until explicitly reset.

### Defeated Opponents Tracking
Added a new history system with a flag icon button that opens a modal listing all defeated opponents. The system automatically records opponents when confirming victory and displays opponent name, persona, and defeat date in chronological order with data management features.

### Card Unlock Improvements
Fixed the curiosity card unlock requirement to trigger on any cat defeat instead of requiring special blush+mole features. This makes the unlock more accessible and consistent with other persona-based unlocks.

### Enhanced Content
Added 50+ new mottos including song lyric puns, literary references, and VORTEKS-specific humor to improve variety and entertainment value.

### Documentation Updates
Updated README.md with comprehensive feature documentation and added DIAGNOSTIC.md with technical assessment of the current game state. All documentation reflects the current v2.0 capabilities and provides complete technical details for developers.

## Technical Details

**Files Modified:**
- `index.html`: Added defeated opponents modal and repositioned buttons
- `src/main.js`: Implemented tracking, persistence, and logging improvements
- `src/game.js`: Enhanced logging with defensive type checking
- `src/card-unlock.js`: Simplified curiosity unlock logic
- `styles/main.css`: Improved start screen visual styling
- `README.md`: Complete rewrite with current features and technical details
- `DIAGNOSTIC.md`: Technical assessment of current game state

The changes are additive and scoped to ensure no disruption to existing gameplay while significantly improving the user experience and fixing several quality-of-life issues.
